items.title: Submit Widerspruch against non-recognition as work accident
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Unfallkasse Musterland, Postfach 11 22, 35001 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 12.12.2024. Per the letter's own rule and § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a letter sent by ordinary post counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 3rd day after posting: Sun 15.12.2024; for social-law letters this deemed-delivery day is not shifted even though it falls on a Sunday. Counting of the one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X) and ends one month later per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: Wed 15.01.2025. That day is a normal working day (not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday), so no further shift applies (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X). The Widerspruch must reach the Unfallkasse by this date.
